verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a dedicated Keyboard shortcuts help article, and a community user reports the web interface was "a ton faster" than ProtonMail. The evidence gives only the article title, though, so how far the shortcuts reach is unknown. Nothing in the pack mentions a command palette. Missing for 10: any evidence of a command palette, detail on how complete the shortcut set is, and independent hands-on confirmation that the interface never makes the user wait.
